description.zh: 远程实例ID。用来指定需要进行网络互通的远程实例ID，要求与当前实例在同一专有网络下。
description.en: Instance ID of the remote instance. Specifies instance ID of the remote instance with which you want to establish network connectivity. The remote instance must be in the same virtual private cloud (VPC) as the current instance.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch add-connectable-cluster --instance-id es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body instanceId_:_es-cn-09k1rgid9000g0000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
